description: This file defines the AssetsService class which provides methods to manage asset metadata, such as listing assets, retrieving a specific asset by ID, and creating new asset metadata entries. It acts as a service layer interfacing with an underlying repository.

classes.name: AssetsService
classes.description: Service class for asset metadata operations, providing an interface to list, retrieve, and create assets.
